examples.english: I was looking at the computer for a long time, so my eyes got tired.

notes:
{目|め} is one of the most common body part words, appearing in many expressions and compounds.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have poor eyesight
- {目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧: to wake up
- {目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: eyes get tired
- {目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close one's eyes
- {目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: visible
- {目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: eye-catching

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦めがね→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧: glasses (eye + metal)
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧: eye drops
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}→目覚まし時計：03159_mezamashidokei⟧: alarm clock

COUNTER SUFFIX:
〜{目|め} also serves as an ordinal suffix: ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{目|め} (first), ⟦{二|ふた}つ{目|め}→二つ目：30351_futatsume⟧ (second).
